name: value-data-100k
note: Predeclared 2026-11-04 before any data (Jerry: scale the value data up further). Same producer and fields as value-data-10k: 100,000 self-play games of the served planner_offer_accept (fresh seeds 2650000-2749999), turn-start and end-of-turn positions with 40 observation-only features, served leaf and shared score, labelled with the final winner; no playouts. Train = first 95,000 games, test = last 5,000; the test split is not read until a training config is committed. Runs on ultra from a frozen snapshot; data stays on ultra (training runs there), receipts copied back to runs/ on the mini.
